title: Issue #668 下个版本产品路线图
description: 基于 2026-06-29 用户反馈 #668，识别安装恢复、agent 友好输出、降级诊断解释和 doctor 摘要的产品优化机会。

1.label: Issue #668 下个版本产品路线图

decisions.q: 下个版本主题应该围绕什么？
decisions.answer: 优先做 first-run recovery and diagnostics polish，而不是继续扩大语言/框架语义覆盖。
decisions.note: #668 是 2026-06-29 0.10.1 之后的真实用户反馈；价值链断在恢复、解释、机器可读输出，而不是图本身不可用。

decisions.q: 下个版本是否定为 Recovery + Explainability patch release？
decisions.answer: 要。下个版本聚焦安装恢复、稳定输出、降级解释、doctor 摘要，不塞新的语言/框架语义覆盖能力。
decisions.note: Human confirmed. 版本叙事应围绕 first-run trust：命令能恢复、日志能读、降级能解释、bundle 能行动。

decisions.q: P1 剩余方向如何排序？
decisions.answer: 先做 Degraded fallback health first-screen explanation，再做 Doctor bundle compact diagnostic summary，最后再做 Stable non-interactive command output。
decisions.note: 代码现状：fallback 只打印 degraded + doctor 命令，doctor 只打印 bundle path；二者直接对应 #668 的困惑。plain/json 是横切输出框架，风险和范围更大，排后。

1.notes: Confirmed scope: next version is a Recovery + Explainability patch release. Exclude new language/framework semantic coverage unless needed to support diagnostics UX.

1-1.label: Dogfood and release channel isolation

decisions.q: Broken launcher 怎么产品化恢复？
decisions.answer: 把它定义成 shell-level install health/repair 问题：新版 CLI 的 uninstall 只能清 agent 配置，无法修复一个根本启动不了的 stale PATH shim。
decisions.note: 候选实现可以是 install.sh/README/troubleshooting 加 zcodegraph doctor install when reachable；但真正覆盖用户场景需要一条不依赖旧 zcodegraph 可执行文件能工作的恢复命令。

decisions.q: Broken install state 的真实使用场景是什么？
decisions.answer: 这是 maintainer/dogfood dual-channel 问题：同一台机器既要在 ZCodeGraph 仓库里 dogfood 开发版，又要在其他项目里使用 release 版，单一全局 zcodegraph launcher 容易被 dev checkout 污染或遗留。
decisions.note: Human clarified. 不能把它只设计成普通用户 stale shim cleanup；应区分 dev dogfood channel 与 release channel。

decisions.q: 开发版 dogfood 是否允许覆盖全局 zcodegraph 命令？
decisions.answer: 不允许。全局 zcodegraph 命令名保留给 release/installed channel；开发版 dogfood 必须走显式 dev channel。
decisions.note: Human confirmed. 这避免 dev checkout 泄漏到其他项目，也避免 checkout 删除后主命令变成 stale shim。

decisions.q: P0 如何拆成可执行任务？
decisions.answer: 按四条线拆：dev-link 新通道、local-install 迁移、旧 zcodegraph repair 防护、仓库自动化与文档迁移。
decisions.note: 每条任务都应能独立验证，且共同维护 channel invariant：zcodegraph=release，zcodegraph-dev=source dogfood。

1-1.notes: Reframed from generic broken install recovery. The core UX is one maintainer machine using dev ZCodeGraph inside this repo while expecting release ZCodeGraph in other projects; the global zcodegraph command must not silently drift between channels or strand stale source-checkout shims.

1-2.label: Stable non-interactive command output

decisions.q: 第 10 刀是否先做 doctor --bundle --json，而不是全 CLI 输出架构？
decisions.answer: 是。先把 doctor bundle summary 的机器可读输出稳定下来，作为 non-interactive 输出的 tracer bullet。
decisions.note: Scope: add --json only to doctor --bundle; preserve default human output; JSON must be parseable stdout with no chalk/prose prefix; include bundlePath and compact summary fields.

1-2.notes: 第 10 刀完成：为 doctor --bundle 增加 --json 机器可读输出，stdout 为可直接 JSON.parse 的对象，包含 bundlePath 和 compact summary；默认人类输出保持不变。

1-3.label: Doctor bundle compact diagnostic summary

decisions.q: 第 9 刀的 doctor bundle 摘要是否只做 CLI 生成后输出，不改 bundle schema？
decisions.answer: 是。bundle 已经包含 status、graph-stats、per-file taxonomy；本刀只新增读取已生成 bundle 的 compact summary formatter，并在 doctor 成功后打印。
decisions.note: Scope: no source paths, no source slices, no schema migration; summary includes bundle source/engine, graph stats, fallback health, and top taxonomy reasons.

1-3.notes: 第 9 刀完成：doctor --bundle 成功后打印 compact local summary，包含 engine/source、graph stats、fallback health 和 top fallback taxonomy reasons；不改变 bundle schema，不包含源码路径或源码片段。

1-4.label: Degraded fallback health first-screen explanation
1-4.notes: P1 first. Goal: make degraded rust-hybrid fallback health explain itself on the first screen after init/index: graph usability, fallback count, top reason categories, representative safe examples if available, and next action.

1-1-1.label: Explicit development dogfood command

decisions.q: 现有代码里 dev dogfood 最接近的安全入口是什么？
decisions.answer: package.json 已有 npm run cli，它会 build 后直接运行 node dist/bin/zcodegraph.js，不需要覆盖全局 zcodegraph。
decisions.note: scripts/local-install.sh、scripts/agent-eval/audit.sh、scripts/add-lang/bench.sh 仍依赖 npm link/PATH 上的 zcodegraph，应作为本轮迁移对象。

decisions.q: dev dogfood 是否需要稳定短命令 zcodegraph-dev？
decisions.answer: 要。提供 zcodegraph-dev 作为显式开发版入口；zcodegraph 继续只代表 release/installed channel。
decisions.note: Human confirmed. zcodegraph-dev 解决 maintainer 跨项目 dogfood 手感问题，同时保留 channel 可见性。

decisions.q: zcodegraph-dev 应该采用哪种存在形态？
decisions.answer: 采用显式全局 dev shim：只绑定 zcodegraph-dev，绝不绑定 zcodegraph。
decisions.note: Human confirmed. 这保留跨项目 dogfood 手感，同时 release channel 永远拥有 zcodegraph 主命令名。

1-1-1.notes: Current safe local entry exists: npm run cli. Unsafe/default dev channel is scripts/local-install.sh using npm link, plus scripts that assume dev zcodegraph on PATH. Need choose whether to standardize on npm run cli/node dist or introduce zcodegraph-dev.

1-1-2.label: Legacy global dev shim migration

decisions.q: 旧 scripts/local-install.sh 是否保留 npm link 覆盖 zcodegraph 的原语义？
decisions.answer: 不保留。local-install.sh 改成迁移入口，调用/指向新的 dev-link 流程，只创建 zcodegraph-dev，不再 npm link 或覆盖 zcodegraph。
decisions.note: Human confirmed. 这是刻意 break maintainer 旧习惯，防止未来继续把 dev checkout 泄漏到 release channel。

decisions.q: 迁移脚本发现旧 dev zcodegraph shim 时是否自动清理？
decisions.answer: 默认不自动清理，只打印精确命令；提供显式 flag 才清。
decisions.note: Human confirmed. --repair-zcodegraph 只能清理明确指向当前 checkout 的旧 dev shim，避免破坏 release install 或用户自定义命令。

1-1-2.notes: Migration wrapper prints exact repair guidance by default. A destructive repair requires explicit --repair-zcodegraph and must only remove a zcodegraph shim that can be proven to point at the current checkout's dist/bin/zcodegraph.js.

1-1-1-1.label: Repo-local zcodegraph-dev wrapper
1-1-1-1.notes: Not selected as primary path: repo-local commands remain useful for tests and docs, but do not satisfy cross-project dogfood ergonomics alone.

1-1-1-2.label: Global explicit dev shim

decisions.q: zcodegraph-dev shim 默认写到哪里？
decisions.answer: 默认写 ~/.local/bin/zcodegraph-dev，并允许 --bin-dir <dir> 覆盖。
decisions.note: Human confirmed. 默认匹配现有用户级命令目录；--bin-dir 支持 CI、临时验证和非标准 PATH。

decisions.q: zcodegraph-dev 每次运行时是否自动 build？
decisions.answer: 默认自动 build，但提供 --no-build 安装模式。
decisions.note: Human confirmed. 默认保证 dogfood 跑当前源码；循环 benchmark/eval 可选择 no-build 并手动预构建。

decisions.q: 第一刀是否先实现 scripts/dev-link.sh 最小闭环？
decisions.answer: 是。先实现 dev-link 新入口和最小 smoke 验证，不先改 local-install.sh。
decisions.note: Human confirmed. Scope: zcodegraph-dev only, temp --bin-dir verification, no zcodegraph mutation.

1-1-1-2.notes: dev-link writes ~/.local/bin/zcodegraph-dev by default, with --bin-dir <dir> override. Generated shim defaults to npm run build before exec node dist/bin/zcodegraph.js; --no-build writes a faster shim for prebuilt benchmark/eval loops. It must never create or replace zcodegraph.

1-1-1-3.label: Release package secondary dev bin
1-1-1-3.notes: Rejected: release packages should not expose a dev-named bin, because release channel semantics stay clean and zcodegraph-dev belongs to source checkout dogfood setup.

1-1-1-2-1.label: scripts/dev-link.sh installs zcodegraph-dev only
1-1-1-2-1.notes: Implemented scripts/dev-link.sh. It writes zcodegraph-dev only, supports --bin-dir, warns when bin dir is not on PATH, and never creates/replaces zcodegraph. Verified by __tests__/dev-link.test.ts.

1-1-1-2-2.label: zcodegraph-dev build mode contract
1-1-1-2-2.notes: Implemented build mode contract. Default generated shim runs npm run build before exec; --no-build skips build for prebuilt benchmark/eval loops; generated shim preserves shell argument passthrough using the standard "$@" form. Verified by __tests__/dev-link.test.ts.

1-1-2-1.label: scripts/local-install.sh migration wrapper

decisions.q: 第二刀是否实现 local-install.sh 迁移 wrapper？
decisions.answer: 是。把 local-install.sh 从 npm link 覆盖 zcodegraph 改成兼容迁移入口：默认调用 dev-link 安装 zcodegraph-dev，--undo 只移除 zcodegraph-dev。
decisions.note: Scope: no legacy zcodegraph repair yet; that留给 1-1-2-2。

1-1-2-1.notes: Implemented scripts/local-install.sh as migration wrapper. It no longer npm-links or modifies zcodegraph; default invocation routes to dev-link/zcodegraph-dev, and --undo removes zcodegraph-dev only. Verified by __tests__/dev-link.test.ts.

1-1-2-2.label: Legacy zcodegraph dev shim detection and repair

decisions.q: 第三刀是否实现 legacy zcodegraph dev shim 检测与显式 repair？
decisions.answer: 是。dev-link/local-install 默认检测并提示 PATH 上指向当前 checkout 的旧 zcodegraph dev shim；只有显式 --repair-zcodegraph 才删除该 shim。
decisions.note: Scope: only proven current-checkout dev shim may be removed; ambiguous zcodegraph/release/user-owned commands must be left untouched.

1-1-2-2.notes: Implemented legacy zcodegraph dev shim detection and explicit repair in scripts/dev-link.sh, with pass-through support from local-install.sh. Default warns and prints repair command; --repair-zcodegraph removes only a proven current-checkout dev shim and leaves unrelated release/user-owned zcodegraph commands untouched. Verified by __tests__/dev-link.test.ts.

1-1-3.label: Repository automation uses zcodegraph-dev channel

decisions.q: 第四刀是否迁移仓库自动化到 zcodegraph-dev channel？
decisions.answer: 是。迁移 scripts/agent-eval/audit.sh 和 scripts/add-lang/bench.sh，不再要求 npm link 或 PATH 上的 dev zcodegraph。
decisions.note: Scope: use zcodegraph-dev / explicit dev bin path; preserve release/latest/version evaluation behavior where relevant.

1-1-3.notes: Migrated scripts/agent-eval/audit.sh local mode to build once, install a temporary zcodegraph-dev --no-build shim, and pass CG_BIN through indexing and run-all. Migrated scripts/add-lang/bench.sh to use ZCODEGRAPH_DEV_BIN or zcodegraph-dev and pass CG_BIN to run-all. Verified by bash -n and __tests__/dev-link.test.ts.

1-1-4.label: Dogfood channel tests and release notes

decisions.q: 第五刀是否做 dogfood channel release notes 与最终验证收口？
decisions.answer: 是。补 CHANGELOG Unreleased 说明 zcodegraph-dev dogfood channel，并跑脚本语法、聚焦测试和 diff check。
decisions.note: Scope: 不再扩展 P1 diagnostics/output；本刀只完成 P0 收口。

1-1-4.notes: Added CHANGELOG Unreleased entry for zcodegraph-dev dogfood channel. Final verification: bash -n scripts/dev-link.sh scripts/local-install.sh scripts/agent-eval/audit.sh scripts/add-lang/bench.sh; npx vitest run __tests__/dev-link.test.ts; git diff --check.

1-4-1.label: Fallback summary data contract

decisions.q: 第 6 刀是否先实现 fallback summary 数据/文案 contract？
decisions.answer: 是。先抽 reusable summary contract 和 formatter，再接 CLI 输出。
decisions.note: Scope: no init/index behavior change beyond exported helper/tests unless needed; avoid source paths/source slices in first-screen contract.

1-4-1.notes: 第 6 刀完成：抽出 rust-hybrid fallback summary contract/formatter，包含 fallbackState、fallbackFileCount、missing fallback counts、reason taxonomy、top reasons 和 graph usability wording；CLI 复用 formatter，保持现有 degraded doctor hint 行为。

1-4-2.label: Init and index degraded health message

decisions.q: 第 7 刀是否把 degraded fallback health message 接到 init/index 首屏？
decisions.answer: 是。复用第 6 刀 summary/formatter，在 init 和 index 成功路径显示可理解的 degraded health 首屏解释。
decisions.note: Scope: keep behavior narrow; no diagnostic bundle generation change; first-screen output avoids source paths and source slices; tests pin CLI-visible wording.

1-4-2.notes: 第 7 刀完成：init/index 的 rust-hybrid degraded 首屏提示现在复用 fallback summary formatter，展示 graph usability 文案、top fallback reason counts 和 doctor bundle 命令；真实 CLI 输出测试已钉住关键文案。

1-4-3.label: Fallback health regression coverage

decisions.q: 第 8 刀是否只补 fallback health regression coverage，不再扩首屏功能？
decisions.answer: 是。把第 6/7 刀的 contract 和 CLI 首屏行为钉成回归测试，避免后续 doctor/status 改动把 degraded health 文案或数据字段冲掉。
decisions.note: Scope: no product behavior change unless tests expose a gap; prefer focused tests around top reasons, missing fallback counts, and init/index visible output.

1-4-3.notes: 第 8 刀完成：补 fallback health regression coverage，新增 formatter missing fallback reason 断言，并新增真实 rust-hybrid init degraded 首屏输出测试；相关 fallback summary/index/init 测试共 15 个通过。
